_nota: Contraparte en inglés de assistant_ui.json (2026-11-15): el rótulo, los alias y el `about` de cada consola, pestaña, modo y panel que no está apartado en esta versión, emparejados por id con el inventario en castellano, que sigue siendo la fuente de la estructura (`kind`, `places`, `intent`). Los alias van como los deja `catalog.plain()`: minúsculas ASCII sin puntuación, el primero el rótulo, y ninguno repetido entre paneles. Traducción automática, sin revisar por una persona; lo vigila tests/test_assistant_ui_en.py.

crew.label: Crew console
crew.about: The on-board console: the status of whoever uses it, their alerts, their log and their tests.

ground.label: Earth console
ground.about: The Earth console: what has arrived from on board with the light delay, the history and the trends.

home.label: Home
home.about: The main screen: mission and crew status, the four vital signs with their 24 h curve, the RIDGE hazards, the next actions and the routes, as in the mockup.

radiation.label: Radiation
radiation.about: Flight radiation: sources, domain level, particles of the last 24 h, dosimetry, NASA-STD-3001 limits, effects, countermeasures, route with the projected dose and shelter.

isolation.label: Isolation
isolation.about: Isolation and psychosocial health: behavioral indicators, 14-day trend, sleep, mood, Cognition battery, nutrition, correlations, risk, recommendations and alerts.

gravity.label: Gravity
gravity.about: Gravitational health: exposure and phase, musculoskeletal, cardiovascular and fluids, tests, exercise consistency, fields, prediction and countermeasures.

environment.label: Environment
environment.about: Spacecraft environment: environmental status, limits, 72 h trend, atmosphere, temperature, light and sleep, noise, water, microbiology, gravity, systems and correlations.

nodes.label: Distance and nodes
nodes.about: The ISS mockup by location: distance and communications, the integrated tests panel with the Polaris viewer, and the reserves of medications, food and equipment.

hazards.label: Hazards and alerts
hazards.about: The status summary, the active alerts with their detail and what to do, and the five hazards of flight. Alerts are acknowledged here.

received.label: Received status
received.about: The latest that has arrived from on board, with the light delay: the status, the five hazards, the projections and their check, and the notes for the crew.

history.label: History
history.about: The crew member's history: baseline, mission by mission, reported pain, received ultrasounds and post-flight recovery.

trends.label: Trends
trends.about: The trend charts of each indicator throughout the mission: how the vital signs evolve.

habitat.label: Habitat
habitat.about: The crew against the shared habitat, the cabin air, radiation, the mission level and the twins' questions.

framework.label: Framework and sources
framework.about: The NASA framework and the sources: HRP risks, datasets, facilities, cost of measuring, people and testbeds.

ledger.label: Ledger and documents
ledger.about: The signed ledger (audit), the documentation to export and the Polaris copy.

library.label: Library
library.about: The countermeasure library, the guides on how to measure each thing and the glossary of terms.

environments.about: One tab per mission environment (low Earth orbit, cislunar, Moon, transit and Mars surface) with what its source says; the environment can be declared from there.

lowVision.label: Low vision
lowVision.about: Larger text, controls and strokes, to see the screen better.

essential.label: Essential mode
essential.about: Leaves only the sections that are indispensable for acting.

privacy.label: Privacy
privacy.about: Hides names, personal figures and notes when someone else is present; alerts and general status stay visible.

voice.label: Voice: read each new alert
voice.about: With voice on, each new alert is read aloud once.

proactive.label: EMMA takes the initiative
proactive.about: EMMA greets, reads the status and warns on its own about new alerts, overdue measurements, mission level and solar event.

followSensor.label: Follow the sensor
followSensor.about: The view rotates by itself with the device's gyroscope.

followFace.label: Follow the face (demo)
followFace.about: The view rotates by itself following the face of whoever is looking, using the camera (demonstration).

wakeWord.label: Listen for «EMMA»
wakeWord.about: Hands-free: the console hears the word «EMMA» and records the sentence that follows.

rotation.label: Rotate
rotation.about: Rotates the whole screen view: upright, sideways or upside down.

highContrast.label: High contrast
highContrast.about: Raises the contrast of the whole console for strong light or reflections, with the same color meanings; it combines with low vision.

autoPrivacy.label: Automatic privacy with another face
autoPrivacy.about: With «Follow the face (demo)» on, if the camera sees another face, EMMA turns privacy on by itself and says so; otherwise it only suggests it (demo, without validation; only counts faces).

home-location.label: Crew location
home-location.about: The backend's mission profiles; the declared one is marked. Choosing one changes the dashboard's route; on other tabs, the card says that tab's aspect in the chosen profile.

home-module.label: Sublocation
home-module.about: The crew member's module and since when: declared by the console or estimated by the module anchors. Its drop-down declares the module, signed in the record.

home-global.label: Overall crew status
home-global.about: Mission status with its level, domains by RIDGE hazard, the four vital signs with their curve, the 24 h trend and the body with the organs on alert.

home-crew.label: Crew member card
home-crew.about: The crew member: their level, the mission phase and the mission time.

home-ridge-individual.label: Crew member RIDGE hazards
home-ridge-individual.about: The five RIDGE hazards by letter, with the level of each of the crew member's domains.

home-logbook.label: Notes and logbook
home-logbook.about: The crew member's latest log entries; from here «Log and tests» opens for writing.

home-risk.label: Risk status
home-risk.about: The current overall level, large, and the other levels of the scale below it.

home-next-actions.label: Next actions
home-next-actions.about: The open follow-ups and the first recommendations, three in total.

home-ridge-quick.label: RIDGE hazards: quick access
home-ridge-quick.about: Each RIDGE hazard with the level of its domains, not aggregated, and for distance the light time; shortcuts to «Body» and «Quality and sensors».

home-routes.label: Space routes
home-routes.about: The mission profile on display: day, distance and delay from the ephemerides, dose, gravity, predicted projections of the status and aspects of the profile.

rad-nav.label: Radiation subsections
rad-nav.about: The section strip: it leads to radiation, exposure, effects, prevention, prediction and history, and gives the current mission, its day and its phase.

rad-spectrum.label: Electromagnetic spectrum
rad-spectrum.about: The order of the spectrum bands, from most to least energy, and where ionizing radiation begins; no figures. Dose in space comes from particles, which are not in it.

rad-sources.label: Other relevant sources
rad-sources.about: The current solar particle event according to DONKI, the dated solar cycle note and what is known about Orion's on-board warning, in the backend's own sentences.

rad-now.label: Radiation status (current)
rad-now.about: The level of the radiation domain now, with its word and its shape, and where it is heading if it changed.

rad-levels.label: Radiation alerts and levels
rad-levels.about: The engine's scale of levels with the radiation domain's level marked, and how many radiation alerts are active.

rad-weather-now.label: Particle environment (now)
rad-weather-now.about: The latest sample of proton flux at 10 MeV or above and of the solar wind, with NOAA's S1 reference alongside, not evaluated. It is the environment at GOES and L1, not at the spacecraft.

rad-exposure.label: Exposure by location
rad-exposure.about: What each mission profile's source says about its radiation environment, with its planet; the declared profile is marked.

rad-dosimetry.label: Dosimetry and monitoring
rad-dosimetry.about: The absorbed dose rate on board with its curve, this mission's dose inferred with its quality factor, and the ring against the career limit.

rad-limits.label: Dose limits
rad-limits.about: The NASA-STD-3001 career limit with its source and the short-term limits per organ from Table 4.8-1, in their unit.

rad-effects.label: Health effects
rad-effects.about: The effect sentence of the Radiation risk entity with its HRP record, and the body regions with the level of their domain.

rad-crew.label: Crew member: RIDGE
rad-crew.about: The crew member's five RIDGE letters with the level of their domains, the radiation one highlighted, and their location if recorded.

rad-tests.label: Tests and monitoring
rad-tests.about: What measures the radiation risk and with what equipment: dosimeter, calculation on the dosimetry and blood analysis.

rad-route.label: Space route and estimated exposure
rad-route.about: The profile's route and the dose: what is integrated to date, inferred, and the projection to end of mission, predicted.

rad-history.label: Exposure history
rad-history.about: The crew member's declared previous missions with their days and their dose if known.

rad-management.label: Recovery and risk management
rad-management.about: The library's countermeasures for the radiation risk, as in its matrix row.

rad-space-weather.label: Space weather
rad-space-weather.about: The curves of the last 24 h of proton flux and solar wind, observed: EMMA does not forecast.

rad-shielding.label: Shielding and protection zones
rad-shielding.about: What is known about shielding and shelter: the procedure if an event is in effect and what the source says about the end of sheltering.

rad-recommendations.label: Radiation recommendations
rad-recommendations.about: The status recommendations for the radiation domain, as given.

grav-exposure.label: Gravity exposure summary
grav-exposure.about: The currently declared gravity, the surface gravity of Earth, Moon and Mars, and the mission day.

grav-transition.label: Phase and transition
grav-transition.about: The mission phases with the current one marked and the days remaining, with the backend's basis for the phases.

grav-risk.label: Risk status (gravity)
grav-risk.about: The worst level among the musculoskeletal, bone and cardiovascular domains, each with its own, and the active alerts.

grav-musculo.label: Musculoskeletal system
grav-musculo.about: Lean mass, bone density, strength, grip and resorption with their change over the mission; the body in muscle and in bone.

grav-cardio.label: Cardiovascular system and fluids
grav-cardio.about: Heart rate, pressure, orthostatic drop, jugular by ultrasound, hematocrit and peak VO2; the body with its vessels.

grav-tests.label: Tests and assessments
grav-tests.about: The catalog tests (IMTP, grip, DXA, tandem walk, sit-to-stand, orthostatic, jugular, VO2) and when the last one was.

grav-training.label: Training: consistency
grav-training.about: Days with exercise in 7 days, streak, and averages of exercise and impacts. No points or challenges.

grav-fields.label: Gravity field comparison
grav-fields.about: Surface gravity of Earth, orbit, Moon and Mars, and this mission's exposure in the current environment.

grav-transition-risks.label: Transition risks
grav-transition-risks.about: Loss of balance (tandem walk), hand-eye coordination (motor praxis, MPT) and space motion sickness (no indicator): mission readings, change from the first and 30-day curve.

grav-prediction.label: Simulation / prediction
grav-prediction.about: The backend's trend extrapolation for these indicators, with its sentence: it is not a clinical forecast.

grav-exercises.label: Exercises and countermeasures
grav-exercises.about: The backend's recommendations for these domains or, when there are none, the bone and musculoskeletal countermeasures.

iso-header.label: Isolation and psychosocial health
iso-header.about: The section title with the mission profile, the time of the data and the crew member.

iso-indicators.label: Behavioral indicators
iso-indicators.about: How many behavioral indicators of the catalog have a reading in the last 24 h, and the latest mood, sleep, circadian misalignment and PVT. There is no composite index.

iso-trend.label: 14-day trend
iso-trend.about: The 14-day curves of self-reported mood, sleep and PVT, each on its own range and told apart by stroke.

iso-factors.label: Factors (weekly change)
iso-factors.about: The change in the mean of the last 7 days against the previous 7 for each behavioral indicator. Descriptive: it does not evaluate.

iso-global.label: Overall isolation status
iso-global.about: The engine's level for the behavioral domain, its trajectory and its reasons, in the backend's sentences.

iso-mood.label: Mood
iso-mood.about: Radar of the six behavioral indicators: where each one's latest reading falls within its own 14-day range.

iso-sleep.label: Sleep and circadian rhythm
iso-sleep.about: Sleep duration and efficiency and circadian misalignment, 7-day means with their change, and the hours of sleep over 14 days as bars.

iso-interactions.label: Crew interactions
iso-interactions.about: Messages, events and leisure hours, and reminders, over 7 days from the planner; team cohesion is not measured.

iso-light.label: Light exposure
iso-light.about: The habitat's cabin illuminance: latest, mean and maximum over 24 h with its curve. It is not the light at the eye and it is not evaluated.

iso-nutrition.label: Nutrition and menu
iso-nutrition.about: The mean energy intake over 7 days and food acceptability, with the backend's sentence.

iso-tests.label: Cognitive tests
iso-tests.about: The tests of the Cognition battery in their order, with their accuracy in the last session or marked as not recorded.

iso-progress.label: Logging consistency
iso-progress.about: Days with PVT, streak of consecutive days, days with a mood self-report and Cognition sessions; no points or levels.

iso-correlations.label: Behavioral correlations
iso-correlations.about: Key correlations: the highest-r pairs the backend finds among the behavioral indicators, and a reading by the local model, marked as AI draft.

iso-risk.label: Behavioral domain risk
iso-risk.about: The risk engine's level and score for the behavioral domain; it is not a probability.

iso-recommendations.label: Behavioral recommendations
iso-recommendations.about: The backend's behavioral recommendations; with none active, the library's countermeasures for the behavioral risk.

iso-alerts.label: Behavioral alerts
iso-alerts.about: The active alerts of the behavioral domain with their level and what changed, and the shortcut to Hazards and alerts.

env-header.label: Spacecraft environment
env-header.about: The title with the mission profile, the time of the data and each environment block with its status: no reading, or how many out of limit.

env-global.label: Overall environmental status
env-global.about: Whether any cabin reading is outside its standard limit or its comfort zone right now, with the limit the backend cites.

env-index.label: Parameters within limits
env-index.about: How many evaluated habitat parameters are within their limits. There is no composite environmental index.

env-trend.label: 72 h environmental trend
env-trend.about: Cabin temperature, humidity and CO2 over the last 72 h, each curve on its own range.

env-risk.label: Limit excursions in 72 h
env-risk.about: The limit excursions of the last 72 h, split into comfort or target and standard limit.

env-air.label: Atmosphere and air quality
env-air.about: Oxygen, CO2, pressure, humidity, carbon monoxide, ammonia and formaldehyde with their latest reading and, where a single limit applies, a bar against it.

env-thermal.label: Temperature and thermal comfort
env-thermal.about: Cabin temperature over its standard range with the backend's comfort zone.

env-light.label: Light and circadian cycle
env-light.about: Cabin illuminance, latest, mean and maximum over 24 h with its curve, and the duration of the last sleep. Light is not evaluated.

env-noise.label: Cabin noise
env-noise.about: Cabin noise, its 24 h maximum and its standard limit.

env-water.label: Drinking water
env-water.about: Bacteria, total organic carbon and silver in the drinking water: shown and not evaluated.

env-microbiology.label: Environmental microbiology
env-microbiology.about: Culturable bacteria from the air and the surfaces: shown and not evaluated.

env-gravity.label: Gravity exposure
env-gravity.about: The backend's gravity regime, the mission time and the level of muscle, bone and neuro-ocular, with the body as a decorative hologram.

env-systems.label: Habitat systems
env-systems.about: The declared status of the habitat systems; with no declaration, undeclared.

env-correlations.label: Environment correlations
env-correlations.about: The highest-r pairs the backend finds among the measured indicators. Correlation, not cause.

home-social.label: Social connection and outreach
home-social.about: Mockup card about activities and outreach with the community; no data behind it.

home-outreach.label: Extension: Earth and communities
home-outreach.about: Mockup card about use in isolated populations and emergencies; no data behind it.

home-essential.label: Urgent help
home-essential.about: The red card to ask for urgent help: the crew sees it at once, whoever is closest first, and Ground one light time later.

home-diagnostics.label: Integrated diagnostics
home-diagnostics.about: Available tests with their count, the latest segmented volume (Polaris) as a pre-flight reference, the analysis of the status and the 30-day laboratory trends.

home-distance.label: Distance and communications
home-distance.about: Distance to Earth, the Moon and Mars and their light time for the chosen profile, computed locally with SPICE, and the nodes that really exist.

home-sync.label: Synchronization and data
home-sync.about: The real status of the link with Ground and of offline mode, which is the nominal one, and what the backend says about local storage.

nodes-distance-risks.label: Risks and challenges of distance
nodes-distance-risks.about: Each challenge of distance for the chosen profile: career dose against the limit, gravity, latency and declared resources, with the level of their RIDGE domains.

nodes-correlations.label: Variable correlation
nodes-correlations.about: Pairs of the crew member's series over 30 days with their Pearson r, n and 95 % interval, and the scatter of the chosen pair. Correlation, not cause.

nodes-scenarios.label: Scenarios and prediction
nodes-scenarios.about: The status projections, the projected dose at end of mission, how many past projections were right and the backend's first recommendation.

home-reserves-status.label: Resources and inventory
home-reserves-status.about: Medications, food and medical equipment according to the signed counts: items in stock, below minimum and minimum autonomy. Stock can be declared here.

home-reserves-medications.label: Medications: management
home-reserves-medications.about: Each counted medication with its stock, its autonomy and the alternatives of the same family; those below their minimum come first.

home-reserves-nutrition.label: Food and nutrition
home-reserves-nutrition.about: The latest signed energy intake and appetite, and the food acceptability computed by the backend.

home-reserves-resupply.label: Resupply
home-reserves-resupply.about: The next declared resupply and each category's coverage and margin until it arrives.

countermeasure-library.label: Countermeasure library
countermeasure-library.about: The whole countermeasure library, grouped by RIDGE hazard: action, support, contraindications, effects, crew time, follow-up and resources. It can be filtered by family.

library-research.label: Under research: not offered
library-research.about: Shows the countermeasures still under research that are not offered on board, such as negative pressure or artificial gravity, with their RIDGE hazard, status and the source's sentence.

library-searched-not-found.label: Searched and not found (library)
aliases: searched and not found in the library
library-searched-not-found.about: Lists what was searched for about countermeasures under research and was not found in the sources.

library-read-not-included.label: Read and not included
library-read-not-included.about: Lists what was read about countermeasures under research and left out, with the reason.

library-what-was-read.label: What was read (library)
library-what-was-read.about: Lists the sources read about countermeasures under research: what was read from each, when, and its address.

library-how-to-read.label: How to read it (library)
library-how-to-read.about: Explains how to read the countermeasure library: the criterion of each family and how each countermeasure is assigned to its RIDGE hazard.

library-ridge-group.label: Library RIDGE group
library-ridge-group.about: The countermeasures of one RIDGE hazard (radiation, isolation, distance, gravity or hostile environment), in a table with their support, cost and follow-up.

library-no-ridge.label: No RIDGE hazard
library-no-ridge.about: Lists the library countermeasures with no RIDGE hazard assigned, in the same table as the rest.

library-no-figure.label: No figure (library)
library-no-figure.about: For a countermeasure with no crew time figure, shows the basis that explains it, with its literal source.

library-source.label: Source (library)
library-source.about: Shows where a library countermeasure's crew time figure comes from.

recommendation-evidence.label: Evidence for a recommendation
recommendation-evidence.about: Lists the evidence a recommendation rests on: the records and studies cited.

recommendation-prior-response.label: Prior response
recommendation-prior-response.about: Summarizes what happened the previous times this countermeasure was adopted, with the caveat that what happened afterwards does not prove it was because of it.

recommendation-prior-response-detail.label: Prior response detail
recommendation-prior-response-detail.about: Unfolds the detail of the prior response: the lines of the last adoption, the earlier ones and what the assessment compares against.

recommendation-earlier-adoptions.label: Earlier adoptions
recommendation-earlier-adoptions.about: Shows what happened each of the previous times this countermeasure was adopted, adoption by adoption.

recommendation-resources.label: On-board resources for a recommendation
aliases: on board resources for a recommendation
recommendation-resources.about: Shows what is on record on board for the resources a recommendation asks for: available, unavailable or undeclared. It is a notice; it does not prevent adopting it.

recommendation-resources-detail.label: Recommendation resources detail
recommendation-resources-detail.about: Unfolds the list of resources a recommendation asks for, each with its declared status and its note.

countermeasure-cost.label: Cost and follow-up
countermeasure-cost.about: Shows what a countermeasure costs: the resources it asks for, the crew time with its basis, and when and how it will be known whether it helped.

mission-level.label: Mission level
mission-level.about: Shows the mission level in effect, which says which measurements are still expected when power or crew time is scarce, and who declared it and why.

mission-level-how-to-read.label: How to read the mission level
aliases: how to read the mission level
mission-level-how-to-read.about: Explains the mission level in effect: which measurements are expected and which are not at this level, and where the criterion comes from.

mission-level-change.label: Change the level
mission-level-change.about: Lets you change the mission level: choose the level, write who and the reason, cite a system and sign it.

alert-check-cost.label: What it costs to check
alert-check-cost.about: Shows what it costs to check an alert: time, where it is processed, when the result arrives, consumables, power and training needed.

alert-detail.label: Detail: what changed, since when and why
aliases: detail what changed since when and why
alert-detail.about: Detail of an alert: what changed, since when, against which baseline, what other signals accompany it, how long it persists and what was happening around it.

baseline-profile.label: Personal baseline
baseline-profile.about: Shows what each indicator is compared against: the crew member's own normal or, while it is learning, only a danger limit, and how it is computed.

baseline-by-indicator.label: By indicator and state (baseline)
baseline-by-indicator.about: Table of the baseline by indicator and state (rest, sleep, activity): median, spread, readings and their provenance.

baseline-catalog-range.label: Catalog range, by indicator
baseline-catalog-range.about: Shows the catalog's reference range for each indicator.

baseline-personal-data.label: Sex and age
baseline-personal-data.about: Explains how declared sex and age are handled: who declares it, that sex only decides whether cycle tracking is offered, the radiation dose and its privacy.

crew-sex.label: Declared sex
crew-sex.about: Shows the declared sex, who declared it and when. On board it can be declared and is signed; on Ground it is read-only, with the delay.

crew-sex-privacy.label: What is stored and how it is deleted
aliases: what is stored and how it is deleted
crew-sex-privacy.about: Explains what is stored about the declared sex, what it is used for and how that entry is deleted separately.

cycle.label: Menstrual cycle
cycle.about: Shows the latest cycle and contraception record, and whether the baseline is adjusted by phase. With sex undeclared or male, it says it does not apply.

baseline-other-flights.label: In other flights, by indicator
baseline-other-flights.about: Shows what was observed in other flights for each indicator (up, down, no change or disputed), with the sentence read and its source. It is context, not what to expect in this person.

baseline-statements.label: Sentences read (baseline)
baseline-statements.about: Lists the sentences read in the sources about how an indicator changes in other flights, with their citation.

summary.label: Summary
summary.about: Shows the summary of the crew member's general status with its level.

alerts.label: Active alerts
alerts.about: Shows the active alerts. Lets you write who is at the console and acknowledge, suppress or inhibit an alert, and it is signed.

recommendations.label: What to do
recommendations.about: Shows what to do: the countermeasure recommendations with their reason and evidence. Lets you adopt one or decline it with a reason, and it is signed.

environments.label: Mission environments
environments.about: Mission environments: profiles such as low Earth orbit, Moon or Mars, each with its particularities.

environment-profile.label: Environment profile
environment-profile.about: Shows what is known about a mission environment, such as low Earth orbit, Moon or Mars, aspect by aspect with its sources, and whether it is the declared one.

environment-declare.label: Declare as the mission environment
environment-declare.about: Lets you declare the environment being viewed as the mission environment, with who and a reason, and it is signed.

hazards.label: The five hazards
hazards.about: Shows the five hazards: radiation, isolation, distance from Earth with its delay, gravity and hostile environment, each with its domains and level.

predictions.label: Projections
predictions.about: Shows the projections: where the indicators are drifting over the coming weeks, with their margin. They are predicted data, not measured. Read-only.

twin-questions.label: The twins' five questions
aliases: the five questions of the twins
twin-questions.about: The twins' five questions answered for a crew member: body, habitat, mission day, countermeasures and what awaits a person's decision.

twin-questions-source.label: Where the questions come from
twin-questions-source.about: Shows which document the twins' five questions come from. Read-only.

twin-answer-provenance.label: Where it comes from (a twins answer)
aliases: where it comes from a twins answer
twin-answer-provenance.about: Shows where an answer to the twins' questions comes from: which panels and status data support it. Read-only.

evidence-entry.label: Scope and reading of an evidence item
aliases: scope and reading of an evidence item
evidence-entry.about: Folded note of a cited source: its scope, for example whether it was measured in animals and not in people, and what was read from it and when. Read-only.

audit.label: Signed ledger
audit.about: Shows the signed on-board ledger: whether the chain of entries verifies, how many there are, its Merkle root and the list of entries with type, signer and time.

context-sources.label: Context sources
context-sources.about: Shows which sources of the team's context were read and which were not, with the reason for the unread ones and what EMMA uses them for. It is inventory; it does not touch crew status.

context-source.label: A context source
context-source.about: A context source, folded: its title and whether it was read; when opened, where it comes from and what was read from it.

credibility-factors.label: The eleven factors of the standard
aliases: the eleven factors of the standard
credibility-factors.about: Shows the credibility factors of NASA's standard for models, grouped, with each one's question and what there is for the inferred or predicted figures.

criticality-axes.label: The two axes of the matrix
aliases: the two axes of the matrix
criticality-axes.about: Shows the axes of the use criticality matrix in NASA's standard, read from its appendix. The matrix has not been applied: each axis is only explained here.

credibility-layer.label: A credibility layer
credibility-layer.about: A layer of inferred or predicted figures, folded: its model, where it is labeled and served, what tests it and each credibility factor explained in words.

datasets.label: Human datasets
datasets.about: Shows the reference human datasets and CIPHER: who they measure, which variables, their collections before, during and after flight, their access and what EMMA uses them for.

dataset.label: A dataset
dataset.about: A dataset, folded: who it measures, its variables, collection schedule, controls, access and its role for EMMA, each with the source's sentence.

dataset-catalog.label: A dataset catalog
dataset-catalog.about: A data catalog, folded: what it is, how it is accessed, what EMMA uses it for and what it is not. Catalogs do not measure anyone.

docs.label: Documentation and export
docs.about: Lets you download as PDF the received status, the chronicle, the received pain and the evidence dossier, and search EMMA's documentation by typing a question.

facilities.label: Columbus facilities: EPM and Biolab
facilities.about: Shows Columbus's EPM and Biolab facilities traced from the facility to the experiment, equipment, data and publication, with what was found and what is missing.

facility.label: A facility
facility.about: A laboratory facility, folded: its experiment and each link of the chain with its status and the source's sentences, or what is missing and where it was searched.

forecast-check.label: Projection check
forecast-check.about: Shows whether the projections were right: each row compares the projected change and its margin with what was measured later. It is model calibration, not a finding about anyone.

framework.label: NASA framework and design hypotheses
framework.about: Shows the NASA framework EMMA starts from and its design hypotheses: the starting gaps, the relation to the IMM, each domain's RIDGE hazard and what was read.

framework-coverage.label: What EMMA does with what it asks (framework)
aliases: what emma does with what it asks framework
what emma does with what it asks
framework-coverage.about: Fold with what each sentence of a NASA source asks for and what EMMA does with it: whether it covers it, partly or not, with the reason and the files.

received-state.label: Latest received status
received-state.about: Shows the latest crew status that has reached Ground with the delay: the general level, the summary and each domain with its level and reasons.

trends.label: Trends
trends.about: Shows the charts of each indicator over time. You can choose the time window, drag to zoom and double-click to go back.

delay.label: Applied delay
delay.about: Shows the signal delay between the spacecraft and Ground: up to when Ground has data, where on board already is and the link status.

environment-choices.label: View or choose another environment
environment-choices.about: Unfolds the list of mission environments, such as low Earth orbit, Moon or Mars, to view or choose another.

display-controls.label: Display (mode controls)
display-controls.about: Display controls: low vision, essential mode, rotate the view, privacy and voice. Lets you turn each mode on or off.

ground-notes-composer.label: Notes from Ground to the crew
aliases: notes from ground to the crew
ground-notes-composer.about: Lets you write and sign a note from Ground for one crew member or the whole crew, as information or a question, and see when each note arrives on board.

hrp-risks.label: HRP risks
hrp-risks.about: Fold with all the risks of NASA's Human Research Program and what EMMA does with each: whether it monitors it, partly, or it is out of its scope.

hrp-domain-scope.label: Scope of each domain
hrp-domain-scope.about: Fold with the scope of each EMMA domain against a Human Research Program risk: which part of that risk each domain monitors.

measurement-cost.label: Cost of measuring
measurement-cost.about: Shows the cost of measuring each indicator: what equipment is needed, how much crew time it takes, where it is processed, when the result arrives and whether it uses consumables.

measurement-cost-searched.label: What was searched (cost of measuring)
aliases: what was searched cost of measuring
measurement-cost-searched.about: Shows what was searched for about the cost of measuring and not found in any source; it is stated, not filled in.

kb-coverage.label: Knowledge base coverage
kb-coverage.about: Shows the list from the team's knowledge base on the cost of measuring and, alongside, where EMMA has it or why it is not included.

ground-dependence.label: Dependence on Ground
ground-dependence.about: Shows what today depends on Ground for measuring and, alongside, what each mission profile says about resupply and return.

ground-mission-history.label: Mission-by-mission history
ground-mission-history.about: Shows, read-only, the crew member's previous missions declared on board that have already reached Ground, with their cross-check against the profile.

mission-profiles.label: Mission profiles side by side
mission-profiles.about: Shows the mission profiles side by side, such as space station, Moon or Mars, with one row per aspect such as delay, duration or autonomy, and marks the chosen one.

profile-matrix-statements.label: Sentences read (mission profiles)
profile-matrix-statements.about: Fold with the sentences read from a mission profile's source, as written, with their page, section and the day they were read.

people.label: People and organizations
people.about: Shows the people and organizations that appear in the sources, with the records they provide or that name them. Only what the records state, no contact details.

organization.label: An organization
organization.about: An organization, folded: the records it provides or that name it, with their title, year, document type and who signs them.

people-no-organization.label: No organization
people-no-organization.about: Fold with the source records that give no organization, with their title, year and who signs them.

people-of-records.label: People in the records
people-of-records.about: Fold with the people cited in the records: each with the records that cite them, their role in them, the year and the record's organization.

polaris.label: Polaris copy
polaris.about: Shows the copy of Polaris code that EMMA carries: which version it is, which tools load, which ones EMMA uses and what was changed. It can be filtered and searched by name.

recovery.label: Post-flight recovery
recovery.about: Shows recovery after flight: each collection against the crew member's own pre-flight range, whether it is inside or outside and when it returns to range.

detection-rule.label: A detection rule
detection-rule.about: Fold with the common risk detection rule, step by step, as the engine applies it.

hrp-risk.label: An HRP risk
hrp-risk.about: An EMMA risk, folded: its RIDGE hazard, the body part, its indicators, the evidence it cites, its levels, countermeasures and its uncertainty.

testbeds.label: Testbeds and validation
testbeds.about: Shows the testbeds on Earth and the validation each would allow: which mission conditions they reproduce and which they leave out, against each RIDGE hazard.

testbed.label: A testbed
testbed.about: A testbed, folded: what it reproduces and what it leaves out, duration, participants, data, providers and what validation it would allow EMMA.

guides.label: How to measure and glossary
guides.about: Explains step by step how to take each measurement, such as blood pressure or temperature, with the source of each step, and a glossary of the console's terms. Read-only.

guide.label: The guide for a measurement
guide.about: The guide for a measurement: which indicators it covers, its steps, what is done in flight and what was searched for and not found. Read-only.

guides-not-found.label: Searched and not found (guides)
aliases: searched and not found in the guides
guides-not-found.about: What was searched for in the sources for this measurement guide and not found. Read-only.

guide-step-source.label: Source of this step
guide-step-source.about: The source of a guide step: the literal sentence in its language, where and when it was read and its evidence record.

glossary.label: Glossary
glossary.about: Console glossary: each term, such as baseline or light time, with its definition and origin. Read-only.

habitat.label: Crew and habitat
habitat.about: Cabin air (CO2, oxygen, pressure, temperature, humidity, noise, gases), light, water, microbes, radiation dose, systems and possible common causes with the crew.

habitat-source-text.label: Source text (habitat)
habitat-source-text.about: The literal sentences of the standard that support what is known about a habitat hypothesis, with their requirement and locator. Read-only.

habitat-countermeasures.label: Environmental countermeasures
habitat-countermeasures.about: Shows the environmental countermeasures proposed for a habitat hypothesis, with their data. Read-only.

habitat-evidence.label: Evidence (habitat)
habitat-evidence.about: Lists the evidence sources that support a habitat hypothesis, with their level and scope. Read-only.

habitat-limits.label: What the standard says about these limits
aliases: what the standard says about these limits
habitat-limits.about: Shows what the standard says about the limits of a cabin parameter, such as CO2, temperature or noise. Read-only.

habitat-references.label: References for a habitat parameter
habitat-references.about: Lists the reference requirements read in the standard for a habitat parameter, such as water or microbes. They are shown, not evaluated.

habitat-personal-light.label: Personal light
habitat-personal-light.about: Shows what was read about the light each person receives: that there is no published limit, and the recommendations from Earth. It is not compared with the reading.

systems-how-to-read.label: How to read it (systems)
systems-how-to-read.about: Explains how to read the status of the habitat systems: a person declares it, it is not telemetry, and what its vocabulary is based on. Read-only.

systems-history.label: Declaration history (systems)
systems-history.about: History of signed declarations of the status of the habitat systems, such as air, water, power or communications, with their module and note. Read-only.

ultrasound-received.label: Received ultrasounds
ultrasound-received.about: On the Earth console, the ultrasounds that have already arrived from the spacecraft, with their measurements and the signs noted. Read-only.

pain-history.label: Reported pain
pain-history.about: On the Earth console, the reported pain that has already arrived: by body area, the current intensity, the previous one and where it is heading. Read-only.

sharing.label: What is shared and what is not
aliases: what is shared and what is not
sharing.about: Says, by type of data, what goes out to the internet, what Ground sees with the delay, what stays on board and what is not stored, and whether the code guarantees it.

sharing-item.label: A type of shared data
sharing-item.about: One data type from the sharing view: where it goes and which part of the code enforces it, or that it does not guarantee it.

sharing-purposes.label: Purposes and hosts
aliases: what goes out to the internet
sharing-purposes.about: The purposes for which EMMA may go out to the internet, with their servers, and whether it is now in offline mode.

sharing-cut.label: Routes with the delay cutoff
sharing-cut.about: The routes Ground requests with the light delay cutoff, and in which direction each one goes.

ground-planner.label: On-board planner
ground-planner.about: For Ground, with the delay: per person and day, tasks done and streak, calendar events and leisure, messages, pastimes from their sheet and reminders. Descriptive figures only.

cognition.label: Cognition battery (NASA)
cognition.about: NASA's Cognition battery: copy the scores of a cognitive test session and record them signed; shows the recorded sessions and the limits of the record.

cognition-source.label: The battery, as read
cognition-source.about: Shows what each test of the Cognition battery measures according to what was read in its source, with the quote.

cognition-figures.label: What each figure is (Cognition)
cognition-figures.about: Explains what each figure of a Cognition battery test is, with the sentence from its source.

pvt.label: PVT test
pvt.about: Psychomotor vigilance test, of reflexes and reaction time: taken here with the keyboard or by touching the screen, with its score and the tests already recorded.

pvt-published.label: What is published and what EMMA does (PVT)
aliases: what is published and what emma does pvt
what is published and what emma does
pvt-published.about: What the published sources say for each parameter of the reflex test and where the value EMMA uses differs. Read only.

pvt-divergences.label: Divergences from what is published (PVT)
aliases: divergences from what is published pvt
pvt-divergences.about: Where EMMA counts the reflex test differently from the published source, for example the lapses. Read only.

region-function.label: Function (region)
region-function.about: Explains what the chosen organ or body region is for, with its sources.

region-state.label: State (region)
region-state.about: Shows the state of the chosen body region, with its level or no data if there are no readings; for the bones, the skeleton figure.

region-variables.label: Variables (region)
region-variables.about: Lists the measured variables of the chosen region, with their deviation from the baseline and their trend if it is concerning.

region-unmeasured.label: No reading (region)
region-unmeasured.about: Lists the indicators of the chosen region that do not have any reading yet.

region-evidence.label: Evidence (region)
region-evidence.about: Shows the evidence for the chosen region: for each domain, how it aligns with NASA risks and the records cited.

region-research.label: Research evidence (region)
region-research.about: Shows what was observed in studies with other people or with animals for the chosen region, not measured in this crew member, with its population and record.

region-trend.label: Trend (region)
region-trend.about: Shows the trend of the chosen region's variables; lets you pick a variable to see its series over time.

region-risk.label: Risk (region)
region-risk.about: Shows the risk of the chosen region: its RIDGE hazard, the risk record and what is known about its uncertainty.

region-countermeasure.label: Countermeasure (region)
region-countermeasure.about: Shows the countermeasures recommended for the chosen body region; in anatomy mode, in the current state, they can be adopted; in the card next to the silhouette they are read only.

region-external-context.label: External context (region)
region-external-context.about: Shows what changed around the mission and environment for the chosen region, warning that coinciding in time is not being the cause.

skeleton-no-voxels.label: Bones without voxels
skeleton-no-voxels.about: Lists the bones that do not appear in the skeleton image because the study does not include them.

skeleton-cut-bones.label: Bones cut by the edge of the study
aliases: bones cut by the edge of the study
skeleton-cut-bones.about: Lists the skeleton bones that are cut by the edge of the imaging study.

skeleton-marked-bones.label: Marked bones
skeleton-marked-bones.about: Lists all the bones marked with a dot on the skeleton figure.
